title: LADA Y vs Teamy McTeamface, Sep 14
notes: LADA Y's first processed game. LADA lists it as an away game at Kirkland, and we wore blue on the away bench (left of center), but the arena scoreboard had us as HOME. The video came as 3600x1440 and was scaled up to Kirkland's usual 3840x1536 for the pipeline. Teamy McTeamface's white jerseys have large sky-blue panels, so our players were told apart from theirs by hue (jersey test "light blue vs sky blue").

Periods from the scoreboard clock, which runs through stoppages at Kirkland: 0:00-18:01, 19:38-38:10 and 40:15-67:51 of the video; it stopped for about 3 minutes at 16:23 of the 3rd. The video runs to the final horn.

Goal times from the team, matched to the scoreboard: ours at 0:28 (clock 17:32 1st), 24:16 (13:20 2nd) and 31:38 (6:01 2nd) of the video; Teamy McTeamface's at 13:30 (4:31 1st, power play), 17:23 (0:38 1st, power play), 32:50 (4:48 2nd), 46:06 (15:20 3rd, power play) and 54:45 (8:36 3rd). The scorekeeper first credited our 17:32 goal to Teamy McTeamface and corrected it after 4:31. Shots on goal from the board: LADA Y 22, Teamy McTeamface 27.

Penalties, from the scoreboard and the players skating into the box: Beregovoy #87 (3 minutes, 6:36-10:08 of the video), Ber #14 (3 minutes from ~5:30 of the 1st, ended by Teamy McTeamface's power-play goal at 4:31), Sokolov #4 (3 minutes from ~3:40 of the 1st, ended by their goal at 0:38) and Lisitsyn #70 (4 minutes from 16:23 of the 3rd; the board first showed 6:00, and a 2:00 for Teamy McTeamface's #88 at the same stoppage was taken off again). Each is solved with 4 of us on the ice and the penalized player off.

Played: 14 skaters, LADA's planned lines but Mischenko #72. Beregovoy #87 is Nathaniel Beregovoy, #67 on LADA's roster: BEREGOVOY 87 on his back, and 87 on SportNinja's game sheet. Didn't play: Belousenko #11, Yafunyaev #29 and Mischenko #72 (never read or seen by the reviewers; SportNinja's sheet agrees). The sheet has Shakhov #78 as not playing too, but SHAKHOV 78 is on his back all game.

Labeled by hand: P1 rows R195 (Shakhov #78 in the scramble before the 0:38 goal) and R132 (Lisitsyn #70 to 12:48, then Lisitsyn #83, as the reviewer saw). Three short gaps remain, at line changes: P1 3:59-4:15 and P2 34:09-34:25 with 4 of us on the ice, and P1 6:11-6:27 with 6.
